SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(424242);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS viat_dead_letter_queue (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  logged_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  workflow_id TEXT,
  workflow_name TEXT,
  execution_id TEXT,
  execution_url TEXT,
  failed_node TEXT,
  error_message TEXT,
  execution_mode TEXT,
  raw_execution_data TEXT,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending_review'
);
INSERT INTO viat_dead_letter_queue
  (workflow_id, workflow_name, execution_id, execution_url, failed_node, error_message, execution_mode, raw_execution_data)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7,
  (SELECT d.data FROM execution_data d WHERE d."executionId"::text = $3::text LIMIT 1))
RETURNING id, execution_id, failed_node, status;
